summary: You can now take a delegation away or delete a group from the Manager, and the four removal actions are clearly defined.

new.title: Take a delegation away
new.text: A delegation row now has a remove button that takes that exact access away on the next run, then clears the row.

new.title: Delete a group from the Manager
new.text: Each group row has a bin that deletes the group in Entra ID after commit. It is refused while anyone still has access through it, and names who.

new.title: Four actions, clearly explained
new.text: Stop managing, Remove, Revoke and Delete are defined once and shown wherever you choose. Each confirmation repeats what survives.

fixes.title: Access map removals really remove access
fixes.text: Removing a link on the Access map deleted only the row and left the access in place. It now stages the removal that takes the access away.

fixes.title: Revoke explains it is temporary
fixes.text: The revoke screen now says a revoked access comes back on the next run unless you also remove the delegation.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes for Windows PowerShell 5.1
fixes.text: On Windows PowerShell 5.1, PIM Manager's own administrators group no longer shows as drift, and misspelt admin names get their suggestion list again.
